## About
German Auto Center Specialists is a repair and maintenance shop in Spring, serving North Houston drivers of Porsche, Mercedes, Audi, BMW, Volkswagen and other German and European cars.
Sean Morris was a German auto enthusiast long before he worked in this shop. He started out as his dad's helper, trained as an automotive technician at Wyoming Technical Institute, and got his first job at a BMW shop in downtown Houston. He still drives the same kinds of vehicles he services.
When you bring your car in, we treat you with respect and keep you out of unnecessary expenses. Reviewers often mention Sean and Angela taking the time to walk them through the work, which is part of why the shop holds a 4.6 rating from 55 Google reviews.

## Services
- Maintenance and repair: Routine maintenance and repair work for German and European vehicles.
- German and European cars: We work on a wide range of German and European car brands.
- Manufacturer parts: We recommend manufacturer parts first, because we believe your vehicle deserves the best.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We are open Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM, and closed on weekends.

Q: Can I text the shop?
A: Yes. You can call or text us at (281) 362-8066.

Q: How do I make an appointment?
A: Give us a call or book online to set up an appointment.

## What customers say
- "Shawn is a genius! I had a check engine light on on my A8, W12 Audi. The dealership tried to fix it for over 1 1/2 years, yes years! I spent around 14,000.00 trying to fix it at the dealership. The last thing the dealership told me was that it was a cracked engine block and they had to pull the engine to verify it. I declined to do it. My lane assist was also not working and they said it would cost over 7,000.00 to fix. I decided to get a second opinion. I took it to Shawn. Shawn kept it for two days and found the check engine light problem was the the dealership had not put the air filter cartridge in the passenger side on the engine air intake. He charged 400.00 to fix a problem that the dealership was not able to fix and charged me 14,000.00. Shawn fixed the lane assist issue for less than half of what the dealership wanted. Needless to say, I highly recommend him! He's honest and he is a genius at auto repairs!" (Steve Cope, 5/5)
